# Ricardo Custódio

**Professor · Researcher · Advisor · Consultant**

Information Security · Cryptography · Digital Signatures ·  
Digital Identity · Electronic Documents · AI & Security

## Research

My research interests include information security, cryptography,
digital signatures, public key infrastructure, digital identity,
electronic documents, post-quantum cryptography, finite field
arithmetic, and artificial intelligence applied to security.

## Current Research

- Digital Identity & Digital Signatures
- Personal AI Agents
- Finite Field Arithmetic
- Post-Quantum Cryptography
